<h1 id="telos-necromancy" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Telos: Necromancy</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes </nowiki><strong><nowiki>very</nowiki></strong><nowiki> strong understanding of </nowiki><span><nowiki>#telos-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>. The rotations listed below are ideally used at 1000%+ enrage. However, they will generally work at a lower enrage as well, and it is encouraged to learn these rotations as early as possible to build good habits and muscle memory. The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1" alt="equilibrium" title="equilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> safe push setup is slower but it will allow for a safer experience whilst climbing enrage and streaking, while the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005205003893485638.png?v=1" alt="equilibrium" title="equilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> fast 2449 farming setup may be used for fast kills while farming this encounter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="notable-enrage-checkpoints-and-changes-999"><nowiki>Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes (999+)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, immortality no longer works P5, and Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> &quot;So you think you can guard?&quot; Achievement, aka Silver Warden</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2700%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>3300%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The first prayer drain on P3 will smite you from full unless Telos touches the beam.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>4000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Hard enrage cap; &quot;True Warden&quot; achievement, aka Gold Warden</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Optional: to reduce P1-2 RNG pushing up from 3000% → 4000%, you can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289319964763.png?v=1" alt="staffoflight" title="staffoflight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at adrenaline crystal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Dummy at War's Retreat: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (should end on 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → enter instance.</nowiki></p>

<h3 id="phase-4"><ins><nowiki>Phase 4</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For information on how to use sticky bombs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in phase 4 for minions effectively, please see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Equip your clearheaded 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102900937460285470.png?v=1" alt="clearheaded" title="clearheaded" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and turtling </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1" alt="turtling4" title="turtling4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> switch.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154071998464.png?v=1" alt="anticlearheaded" title="anticlearheaded" kind="icon" /><nowiki> used here requires taking the fonts slow, or it won't be off cooldown for font 2.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
